generator.program.note: The program the authors chose to grow this taxon's stem succulent species (named in each species' spec until G2.3a moved it here).

traits.note: Abrams's Illustrated Flora of the Pacific States, volume 3 (1951), read in full (Cactaceae by I. L. Wiggins): perianth segments numerous, grading from sepals to petals, imbricated, their bases coalescent in a cup or tube borne on the apex of the ovary; stamens numerous, on the throat of the tube; ovary inferior, 1-celled; style 1, stigma lobes 1 to numerous. Jepson eFlora (as quoted in search results; the page itself was not read): flowers radial, rarely bilateral. No flora counts the tepals.
